leadText:
Starfall Hill (Japanese: ほしふりの丘 Starfall Hill) is an -exclusive location in the Alola region, featured in Showering the World with Love!. Found on Ula'ula Island, it is located atop Mount Hokulani near the Hokulani Observatory.

Starfall Hill is known for the large amount of that fall down there from space. The Minior land on the surface in their , but eventually their shell cracks open. Once the Minior have lost their shell, they vanish into dust. visited Starfall Hill when he was young and made friends with a Minior, only to lose it when it lost it shell.

Years later, and visited Hokulani Observatory with as part of a school trip and watched the Minior fall down from the sky at Starfall Hill. Just like Sophocles did before, Ash's Poipole befriended a Minior, only to lose its friend when it turned into dust. After all the Minior were gone, Ash and his friends spotted a in the sky.
